related.title: LTE OFDMA：資源格中的資料元素
related.titleEn: LTE OFDMA: data elements in the resource grid
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 4.44444444444 ms 與 5.33333333333 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 4.44444444444 ms and 5.33333333333 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1344 information bit/interval與1176 information bit/interval，建立lte_re_mask.csv、TBS邊界註記、保留RE清單，並完成以下驗收：每區間1300資訊位元需求只由20%保留組滿足；此粗算不代替正式TBS表。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1344 information bit/interval and 1176 information bit/interval; create lte_re_mask.csv, TBS limitations and reserved-RE list; apply this acceptance decision: Only the20% reservation meets1300 information bits per interval; this estimate does not replace the transport-block-size tables.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 本課用獨立失敗機率p的簡化停止等待模型E[N]=1/(1-p)；實際軟合併使各次失敗率相關，須另外量測。 展開基準式 4/(1-0.1)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把前十項幾何級數與解析極限比較，保留未加總尾項；不要把p直接當平均重傳次數。 將兩條推導一起存入 harq_attempts.csv、級數尾項、回饋時間表。
從原理 每個資源格需分開資料、參考與控制元素；可用RE乘每RE編碼後資訊位元只估名義容量。 展開基準式 10*12*14*0.8*2*0.5；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以逐PRB遮罩計數RE再乘Qm與碼率；確保保留元素未再次算入資料區。 將兩條推導一起存入 lte_re_mask.csv、TBS邊界註記、保留RE清單。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Use a simplified stop-and-wait model with independent failure probabilityp and E[N]=1/(1-p); real soft combining changes conditional failure rates., expand baseline expression 4/(1-0.1); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compare ten terms of the geometric series with its analytic limit and retain the tail; p is not the mean retry count. Save both derivations with harq_attempts.csv, series-tail checks and feedback timings.

Starting from Separate data, reference and control elements; usable RE times information bits per RE gives only nominal capacity., expand baseline expression 10*12*14*0.8*2*0.5; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Count RE from a per-PRB mask before multiplying Qm and code rate; reserved elements must not be counted twice. Save both derivations with lte_re_mask.csv, TBS limitations and reserved-RE list.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Massive MIMO：固定總功率的陣列增益
related.titleEn: Massive MIMO: array gain at fixed total power
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 4.44444444444 ms 與 5.33333333333 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 4.44444444444 ms and 5.33333333333 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋12.0411998266 dB與18.0617997398 dB，建立array_power.csv、正規化推導、相位誤差圖，並完成以下驗收：15 dB理想增益門檻由64元通過；實際驗收仍需方向圖與旁瓣，不能當全方向增益。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 12.0411998266 dB and 18.0617997398 dB; create array_power.csv, normalization derivation and phase-error plot; apply this acceptance decision: Only64 elements exceed15 dB ideally; acceptance still needs patterns and sidelobes rather than assuming omnidirectional gain.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 本課用獨立失敗機率p的簡化停止等待模型E[N]=1/(1-p)；實際軟合併使各次失敗率相關，須另外量測。 展開基準式 4/(1-0.1)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把前十項幾何級數與解析極限比較，保留未加總尾項；不要把p直接當平均重傳次數。 將兩條推導一起存入 harq_attempts.csv、級數尾項、回饋時間表。
從原理 理想相位校準且固定總發射功率時，指向增益相對單元為10log10N；固定每元功率是不同基準。 展開基準式 10*log10(16)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：每單元功率分別1/16及1/64 W；用場振幅相加再平方驗證總功率基準。 將兩條推導一起存入 array_power.csv、正規化推導、相位誤差圖。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Use a simplified stop-and-wait model with independent failure probabilityp and E[N]=1/(1-p); real soft combining changes conditional failure rates., expand baseline expression 4/(1-0.1); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compare ten terms of the geometric series with its analytic limit and retain the tail; p is not the mean retry count. Save both derivations with harq_attempts.csv, series-tail checks and feedback timings.

Starting from With ideal phase calibration and fixed total transmitted power, directional gain is10log10N relative to one element; fixed per-element power is a different comparison., expand baseline expression 10*log10(16); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Per-element powers are1/16 and1/64 W; add field amplitudes and square to verify the normalization. Save both derivations with array_power.csv, normalization derivation and phase-error plot.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
